description: MC-28289: same-tick held-item swap attacks with the OLD item's attack_damage/attack_speed

setup.platform: kill @e[type=!player]; fill -6 63 -2 6 63 6 minecraft:stone; fill -6 64 -2 6 66 6 minecraft:glass hollow
setup.notes: sword must land in hotbar slot 0, stick in slot 1; verify via ContainerSetContent. Summon NBT identical on both servers (Solaris rejects Silent/Tags); handshake guarantees chunks loaded so absolute coords work.

tolerance.rule: same-tick damage must equal the OLD held item's full-strength damage on the oracle; Solaris passes iff its same-tick damages match vanilla's within 0.01
